source.note: migration file is uncommitted at contract time; sha256 below is authoritative

backup.production_rule: additive only: one new service-role table and one app_settings row inserted with on-conflict-do-nothing; no existing object is altered, so the 2026-09-10 D-061 drill set (restore-proven) is an acceptable restore point

stop_conditions: public.concierge_threads already exists with a different column set
public.app_settings has no primary key or unique constraint on key (the on-conflict clause would fail)
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
concierge_mode may not be set to auto by this release

forward_verification.name: concierge_threads_exists_with_rls
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.concierge_threads') is not null and (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.concierge_threads'::regclass)

forward_verification.name: concierge_mode_defaults_to_suggest
forward_verification.query: select value = '"suggest"'::jsonb from public.app_settings where key = 'concierge_mode'

feature_flags.name: concierge_mode
feature_flags.required_state: suggest after apply; auto only after the Messenger webhook is verified and Business Suite automations are off; off is the kill switch

rollback.safe_until: any time; the table holds only Messenger thread state that the bot rebuilds on the next message

steps.name: silence_bot
steps.action: update public.app_settings set value = '"off"' where key = 'concierge_mode'

steps.name: drop_table
steps.action: drop table if exists public.concierge_threads; delete from public.app_settings where key = 'concierge_mode'
